title: Durable DB and CRUD Runtime
goal: Create a governed durable data layer for OS-owned founder/business records with staged schema, repository, write preview, Command Center UX, tests, docs, and final validation.
userImpact: Operators get a clear DB/CRUD path without live mutation until each boundary is validated.
commandCenterImpact: P134.2 preserves current Command Center UX and prepares display-safe DB runtime model data for P134.4.
safetyImpact: P134.2 is model-only and does not enable DB/runtime writes, CRUD execution, migrations, raw SQL, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or spend.
costImpact: No provider spend; local checks only.

subphases.title: Schema and Repository Model
subphases.narrowGoal: Define a unified durable DB schema and repository model for OS-owned founder/business runtime records without enabling DB reads, DB writes, migrations, or CRUD execution.
subphases.dataShape: Model-only local schema/repository metadata with display-safe entity groups, blocked repository operation intent rows, source pointers to existing db/schema.json and db/sqliteCrudRepository.js, authority flags set false, blockers, next action, owner capability, evidence labels, activity labels, and no raw SQL UX.
subphases.commandCenterUx: Preserve existing Command Center UX. P134.2 does not edit dashboard source or tests and does not add runnable DB controls. P134.4 will consume this model for display-safe UX.
safetyRules: Do not modify project-owned files.
Do not modify dashboard source or tests in P134.2.
Do not modify db/** or local-state/runtime/** files in P134.2.
Reuse existing db/schema.json and db/sqliteCrudRepository.js descriptors without duplicating repository helpers.
Do not create DB schemas, run migrations, connect hosted databases, read or write DB/runtime records, or execute CRUD.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
reuseCheck: Reuse existing OS phase status and roadmap structures.
Do not duplicate SQLite CRUD repository helpers, report writers, checker formatters, mode guards, redaction helpers, or phase status updaters.
testsAndCheckers: Update P134.1 and enterprise readiness checkers for P134.2 handoff.

finalResponseChecklist: Command Center UX changes or preservation

knownLimitations: P134.2 is schema/repository model metadata only.
